verdict.rationale: Base44 publishes SDK and CLI reference docs with code examples, such as `base44.entities.Task.create` and CRUD-capable entity modules. A Docs MCP server lets AI assistants search the documentation. However, nothing shows an interactive, in-browser API explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: interactive API explorer/playground, runnable in-page examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
